text: 创业板指涨超3%，沪指涨1.10%，深成指涨2.21%，白酒、大金融、短剧、物理AI等方向涨幅居前，沪深京三市上涨个股近4600只。
text_en: The ChiNext Index rose more than 3%, the Shanghai Composite rose 1.10%, and the Shenzhen Component rose 2.21%, with baijiu, large financials, short dramas and physical AI among the top gainers, and nearly 4,600 stocks in the Shanghai, Shenzhen and Beijing markets advancing.
